decks.notes: The main concept of this Dragon Stompy deck is to aggressively ramp up and disrupt the opponent's mana base with cards like Blood Moon and City of Traitors, while utilizing powerful dragons like Laelia, the Blade Reforged and Pyrogoyf to quickly close out the game. The inclusion of cards like The One Ring and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker allows for explosive plays and extra value. Overall, the deck aims to apply constant pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan to secure a fast victory.

This deck focuses on quickly filling your graveyard with powerful creatures, then bringing them back onto the battlefield with cards like Animate Dead and Reanimate. By utilizing cards like Entomb and Brainstorm to set up your graveyard and disrupt your opponent's strategy with counter spells like Force of Will, this deck aims to overwhelm your opponent with fast, efficient reanimation combos. With a mix of disruption, card selection, and powerful reanimation targets, this deck is designed to quickly bring out big threats and win the game before your opponent can respond effectively.

The main concept of this Aggro Dragon Stompy deck is to lockdown the opponent's non-basic lands with cards like Blood Moon, Magus of the Moon, and City of Traitors while quickly ramping up mana with Simian Spirit Guide, Chrome Mox, and Lotus Petal. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures like Broadside Bombardiers and Fury while also using powerful spells like Sundering Eruption and Shatterskull Smashing to control the board. The One Ring and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide additional utility and flexibility in various situations.

This Eldrazi aggro deck focuses on deploying powerful Eldrazi creatures quickly and efficiently, using cards like Eldrazi Temple and Eye of Ugin to reduce their cost. It also includes disruptive spells like Thought-Knot Seer to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures like Glaring Fleshraker and Devourer of Destiny, supported by mana acceleration from cards like Lotus Petal and City of Traitors. The key strategy is to apply early pressure and maintain tempo while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to use a combination of cards like Lotus Petal, Dark Ritual, and Doomsday to set up a powerful win condition by sequencing cards in a specific order. The goal is to manipulate your library using cards like Brainstorm and Ponder to ensure that Thassa's Oracle can win the game for you when you cast Doomsday. The deck also includes disruption like Force of Will and Thoughtseize to protect your combo. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student helps dig for key pieces while cards like Psychic Frog provide additional utility.

This deck focuses on aggressive Eldrazi creatures supported by powerful lands and disruption spells. The goal is to quickly deploy large threats like Thought-Knot Seer and It That Heralds the End, while using cards like Chalice of the Void and Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's game plan. With a mix of fast mana from cards like Ancient Tomb and Lotus Petal, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent early in the game and close out the game before they have a chance to stabilize.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's actions through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive creatures. It also aims to generate card advantage and selection through cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder. The deck utilizes a mix of traditional control elements such as Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares, along with newer threats like Murktide Regent and Psychic Frog. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides card advantage and disruption. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements while also applying pressure with Wasteland.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, then using cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead to bring them back onto the battlefield for a game-ending threat. It also includes disruption spells like Force of Will and Thoughtseize to protect the combo and disrupt opposing strategies. The deck also includes cards like Brainstorm and Polluted Delta to ensure consistent card draw and mana fixing. The goal is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats and disrupt their game plan before they can mount a defense.

This deck aims to utilize the combo potential of Nadu, Winged Wisdom along with Nomads en-Kor to create a powerful card draw engine. It also includes cards like Endurance and Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath for graveyard interaction and card advantage. The deck has a strong control element with cards like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Teferi, Time Raveler provides additional disruption and protection, while Green Sun's Zenith helps tutor for key pieces. Overall, the deck focuses on creating a strong board presence while disrupting the opponent's strategy.

This deck revolves around the combo of using Cephalid Illusionist and Nomads en-Kor to mill your entire library, then utilizing Dread Return to bring back Thassa's Oracle for a win condition. The deck also includes various control elements like counter spells and removal to protect the combo and disrupt your opponent's game plan. The key strategy is to efficiently set up and execute the combo while managing your resources effectively to outmaneuver your opponent and secure the win.

The deck revolves around quickly getting powerful creatures into the graveyard and then reanimating them onto the battlefield for a game-winning advantage. With efficient discard spells like Thoughtseize and Cabal Therapy, as well as fast mana sources like Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal, the deck aims to consistently pull off explosive plays. Cards like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty provide strong threats that can quickly turn the tide of the game, while Atraxa, Grand Unifier helps to protect the combo pieces. The deck's goal is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up its own combo to win the game.

This deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan through a combination of counterspells and removal spells, while also putting pressure on them with efficient threats like Murktide Regent and Orcish Bowmasters. The deck prioritizes tempo plays, utilizing cards like Daze and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to stay ahead of the opponent. By controlling the board and keeping the opponent on their back foot, this deck aims to close out the game quickly before the opponent can recover.

The deck focuses on quickly getting creatures on the board, utilizing Ninjutsu to surprise opponents and deal damage with powerful abilities. It also includes control elements like counterspells and removal to protect its creatures and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The goal is to apply constant pressure on the opponent while generating card advantage with abilities like Yuriko's triggered ability. The deck aims to win the game quickly through aggressive attacks and utilizing the synergy between its creatures and spells.

The main concept of this deck is to control the opponent's actions and stall their strategy by utilizing cards like Teferi, Time Raveler, Dress Down, and Consign to Memory. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's plays, while also having a win condition with cards like Phyrexian Dreadnought and Nulldrifter. The deck includes various control and removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Force of Will to maintain board control. The mana base consists of fetch lands and shock lands to ensure consistent mana fixing and access to the necessary colors for spells.

The main concept of this Dragon Stompy aggro deck is to disrupt the opponent's mana base with cards like Blood Moon, Magus of the Moon, and Sundering Eruption, while also putting pressure on them with efficient threats like Pyrogoyf and Broadside Bombardiers. The deck aims to quickly establish board presence and lock the opponent out of playing their spells, allowing the pilot to quickly close out the game. The use of Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide allows for explosive starts, while cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide card advantage and consistency.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty using cards like Thoughtseize, Faithless Looting, and Entomb. Once these creatures are in the graveyard, the deck aims to bring them back to the battlefield by casting Reanimate, Shallow Grave, or Animate Dead to overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats. The deck also includes disruption and protection spells like Unmask and Archon of Cruelty to ensure the combo goes off smoothly and efficiently.
